text: Sanding marks the first task in carpentry work to ready timber for cutting. Prior to making incisions, any splinters or uneven edges must be stripped away. Select appropriate sandpaper according to the specific wood type and intended result, then smooth the surface. With the material now level, sawing starts. Tools like hand or electric saws execute the cuts. A jigsaw or circular saw might suffice depending on requirements. Once cutting finishes, the timber proceeds to shaping and mounting.
